KAUSTUBH SALVI

Thane, Maharashtra, India | +91 9152715693 | kaustubhsalvi205@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Finance Operations professional with experience management, global market settlements and reconciliation across equity, fixed income and swap transactions. Experienced in pre-matching, settlement exception management, trade fail investigation, operational reporting, cash/equity trade workflows and coordination with clients, counterparties, custodians and internal stakeholders.

in Middle Office,

trade

CORE SKILLS • Financial Markets: Trade Lifecycle, Trade Settlement, Equity, Fixed Income, Cash Equities,

Swaps, Global Market Operations

Middle Office Operations: Pre-Matching, Settlement Reconciliation, Trade Exceptions, Trade Fails, Economic Mismatches, DKs, SSI Amendments

Operations & Controls: SOD, MOD, EOD, KRI, M2M, No-Fail Client Reporting, Sensitive Client Reporting, Root Cause Analysis

Systems & Tools: DTC, CTM, Euroclear, SWIFT securities settlement messaging (MT540/MT542), MS Excel, Outlook, Data Reconciliation Tools

Stakeholder Management: Client Communication, Counterparty Coordination, Custodian Coordination, Governance Calls, Management Reviews, Training & Knowledge Transfer

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE eClerx Services Ltd. — Middle Office Senior Analyst | Apr 2026 – Present | Mumbai, India

Manage pre-matching, settlement and reconciliation activities across EMEA, Asia and DTC markets, supporting daily global trade lifecycle operations.

Process and monitor cash equity, swap give-in, matched receipt & delivery and Hong Kong buying trades through post-trade workflows.

Investigate and resolve economic mismatches, DKs, failed trade exceptions and SSI amendments by coordinating with clients, counterparties, custodians and operations teams.

Prepare and monitor SOD, MOD, EOD, KRI, M2M, no-fail client and sensitive client reports to support operational controls and management oversight.

Handle FX booking for TWD and KRW currencies and release trades impacted by kick-outs, supporting timely downstream processing.

Conduct offshore client communication, governance calls and weekly management reviews to discuss trade-fail resolution, operational risks and outstanding exceptions.

Support process improvement, team training and knowledge transfer to strengthen operational consistency and team capability.

eClerx Services Ltd. — Middle Office Analyst | May 2024 – 2025 | Mumbai, India

Supported global market trade settlement across equity and fixed income products, maintaining accuracy throughout the post-trade lifecycle.

Performed trade pre-matching and investigated exceptions to support timely and accurate settlement.

Coordinated with custodians, brokers, clients and internal teams to investigate and resolve trade fails and settlement discrepancies.

Monitored high-volume trade flows, identified real-time settlement breaks and escalated potential operational risks.

Performed root cause analysis on recurring discrepancies and partnered with risk, compliance and reconciliation teams to close daily trade cycles.

Worked with DTC, CTM and Euroclear settlement systems supporting global market trade execution and settlement processes.

KEY ACHIEVEMENT • Received the Super Achiever Award in 2025 for performance and contribution in Middle Office

operations.

EDUCATION Bachelor of Accounting and Finance University of Mumbai | 2020 – 2023

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION • Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi • Location: Thane, Maharashtra, India
